videos.title: Ring's autonomous security robot
videos.description:
The Ring Rover Cam is an autonomous security robot built on Amazon’s Astro home robot. The Verge’s Jen Tuohy saw it in person this week, where the company demoed the 4K camera-on-wheels patrolling a warehouse. It’s mainly designed for businesses and can stream footage to the Ring app when it detects motion and other disturbances, as well as patrol for up to 30 minutes at a time. Sadly, it has none of Astro’s personality…

videos.title: Ring Drone Cam hands-on
videos.description: The Verge’s Jen Tuohy got hands-on with Amazon Ring’s latest flying security camera. The Ring Drone Cam is designed to do five- to eight-minute flights around your home before landing in its dock, where its camera is shuttered. The company says it can even go up stairs. This isn’t Ring’s first flying camera; that was the Always Home Cam, which Jen saw in action at CES 2023. It had more sensors, including LIDAR, but never shipped. videos.title: Tesla is ‘winding down’ production of the Cybertruck
videos.description:
Tesla is getting the Cybertruck ready for retirement in an effort to ramp up its robotaxi output. In an X post on Friday, Tesla CEO Elon Musk said that the company will be “winding down” Cybertruck production at its Texas Gigafactory sometime around the middle of next year, “to make room for increased Cybercab production.”
